limitations: Only start/cancel commands and ready/error are newly native; remaining commands and engine lifecycle stay in the harness.
The inherited pipe is a Windows fixture boundary; callers are serialized and paths exclude whitespace/monitor syntax.
Deadline bounds acceptance and host wait, not interruptibility of arbitrary OS pipe/file operations.
Ready/error timeout and broken-pipe adversarial cases use real OS pipes/files, not a real Renode timeout claim.
CPU loss attempts a real native cancellation write to the terminated Renode process.
No IDE matrix rerun or expanded capability approval.
